## Summary

Claims now carry the versioned **`sig.assertion/1`** envelope end-to-end and bind to the **actual**
`evidence_capture` occurrence the extraction consumed — the connector's real archived bytes — with an
explicit `binding_status`, instead of the synthetic per-run placeholder every claim used to share.

- **`db/src/db/assertion.py`** — the `sig.assertion/1` envelope + the named, versioned
  **`sig.assertion.map.v1`** connector→sink adapter. Preserves typed/raw values, units +
  normalization id/version, valid/observed time with bound kinds + explicit unknown-reasons,
  reliability/directness/integrity (+provisional +legacy tier), polarity/rank/review-status,
  sensitivity tier, rationale, revision/retraction/correction links, evidence role, extraction
  method/version/config-digest/model/prompt, typed locators (validated against `parsing.LocatorKind`)
  and typed qualifiers. Every default carries a named basis recorded on the claim
  (`assertion_map_basis`) — an absent field never silently strengthens evidence.
- **Sqitch `claim_assertion_bindings`** (additive; deploy/revert/verify) — typed claim columns,
  `claim_evidence` locator/binding_status/extractor_version/extraction_config_digest, typed
  `claim_qualifier` columns, `evidence_capture` occurrence key `(artifact, digest, retrieved_at)` +
  `capture_classification`, and append-only **`assertion_quarantine`** (restricted/sealed roles
  only). `claim_evidence` is now append-only — links are inserted, never rewritten.
- **`PgClaimSink`** — binds each claim to the real occurrence + the extraction row that consumed it;
  dedups blobs (`(digest, artifact)`) so identical bytes acquired twice are ONE blob and TWO
  immutable occurrences; registers normalization ids; fail-closed quarantine for bad digests,
  missing bindings, unknown object/value kinds, unsupported locators, missing required fields,
  unknown qualifiers/predicates, OCFL `version_mismatch` and extraction failures — a rejected record
  never suppresses a valid sibling; replay (`is_replay`) binds the ORIGINAL occurrence
  (`retrieved_by_run_id` stays the original run's) so claim `observed_at` keeps the source
  observation time while `sys_period`/`bound_at` record the replay's own assertion time.
- **Connectors** — `ClaimSink.assert_claims(claims, *, capture)` pass-through through the
  pipeline/runner; replay supplies the original-occurrence binding; `CaptureRef` gains
  `ocfl_object_id`/`ocfl_version`/`original_run_id`; `OcflCaptureStore.get/metadata` accept a
  version pin — a replay resolves the version the original extraction consumed, never a mutable
  head sidecar.
- **API (D-P31.1-3 route half)** — `/v1/entity/{type}/{id}` resolves each predicate independently:
  resolver `KeyError`s collect into an explicit `unregistered_predicates` field on `EntityResponse`
  — the entity's registered admissible facts are served, never a whole-entity 404 and never a
  guessed predicate definition. `/v1/resolution/{id}/{predicate}` keeps its honest 404 for unknown
  predicates; restricted claims stay withheld AND unnamed; absent entities still 404.
- **Honest evidence kinds** — `actual_capture` / `replayed` / `document_only` / `legacy_synthetic`
  × `actual` / `synthetic` / `legacy` classification; the no-binding legacy path is never presented
  as byte-anchored provenance.
- **FIELD_MAP published first** (`docs/build/reports/p32.2-assertions/FIELD_MAP.md`) — every
  six-stream field category mapped to existing LinkML/DB homes before the adapter was written; only
  missing typed fields were added through ontology generation.
